behaviorChanges: Plan-review recovery/guard predicates are now exactly consistent with run-plan-review's self-authorization gate: sha-stale-at-cap yields whenever a self-authorized round remains (a blocked bound round the fixes moved past, or a voided run to rebind) and names the successor path only when none does; and the plan-edit guard no longer blocks edits to a plan whose current hash is already bound by a clean manifest. Both close false-block edge cases in 0.10.5's new deadlock logic (no genuine deadlock case changes).

requiredMigrations.command: gh auth refresh --hostname github.com -s read:project -s project
requiredMigrations.description: Carried forward from 0.10.3 for lanes updating across it: grant the gh token the GitHub Projects scopes the fail-closed board gates need. Machines already on 0.10.3+ or whose token carries read:project and project need no action.

rollbackNotes: Pinning back to 0.10.5 restores the two false-block edge cases (a finalized plan edit-blocked by a superseded run's twin; the fix-after-blockers flow routed to a successor plan); the genuine-deadlock successor path is unchanged in both directions.
